title: OpenAI Launches the Agents API in Public Beta, Putting the Codex Harness Behind One API Call
summary: OpenAI has released the Agents API in public beta. It gives developers the same harness and infrastructure that run Codex. OpenAI hosts and maintains the harness. Developers run the agent’s compute in an OpenAI-managed sandbox, their own infrastructure, or a partner sandbox. Is it deployable? Yes. It is live for all developers in public beta.
